name: Proxmox_VE_Cluster_StorageCapacity
description: Capacity, free space and availability for every storage defined in a Proxmox VE cluster, per node.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript: one /cluster/resources?type=storage call per interval.

A shared storage is visible from every node and is therefore discovered once per node, with instance ID storage/<node>/<name>. That is intentional rather than duplication: availability and free space are reported from the perspective of the node doing the asking, and a shared store can be reachable from one node and not another. Group instances by the pve_shared instance property if you would rather alert on shared storage once.

Each instance's name says what kind of store it is -- local (one node's own disk), shared (this cluster's own Ceph, or a store Proxmox is told every node sees) or network (NFS, SMB, GlusterFS, iSCSI, Proxmox Backup Server, or an external Ceph) -- and so does the pve_storage_kind instance property. Discovery reads /storage once to tell an external Ceph (one with a monhost) from the cluster's own; without it, a Ceph store reads as shared.

Each instance carries a topology vertex for Proxmox_VE_Cluster_Topology (predef.externalResourceID and predef.externalResourceType). The keys are written plain, so where topo.namespace or topo.blacklist is set, which rewrites the TopologySource's keys, discovery stamps none: the instances stay, off the map. The vertex is type VMDatastore, as in LogicMonitor's vSphere suite: a local store is one vertex per node, a shared or network store one for the cluster, carried by the instance of the first node by name, so one key sits on one instance. Only the collecting resource stamps keys.

Applies on the cluster role: resources whose pve.cluster.role is active or standby, which the NetScan sets. Only one of the pair collects -- the active resource, or the standby while the active one is down or has lost quorum. The other prints nothing, so its datapoints read No Data and the pair never alerts twice. The suite has no addCategory_* PropertySource: the NetScan sets the categories and pve.cluster.role, and the product page lists them for a resource added by hand.

Requires Datastore.Audit on /storage/{storage}, which the PVEAuditor role includes. /cluster/resources filters storages by privilege rather than erroring, so an under-privileged token sees fewer storages, or none.

Units: capacities in GB. MB and GB are decimal (10^6 and 10^9 bytes); the product page states the suite's convention.

Proxmox storage ##INSTANCE## is not available. Guests with disks on this storage cannot start, and backups targeting it will fail.
